race.comment: KINGSLAND (10) has a good record on this track, and he was left in front here 3 weeks ago, which counted against him late, weakening to finish fourth on a heavy surface. He drops 5.5kg with the rise in class, and a stronger tempo will allow him to settle into this rhythm just off the pace this time. Stick with him. Can win. THE DEPUTY (1) save his best for his home course here, and he was beaten by a nose on a heavy track here 3 weeks ago at this level. He is even better on good ground, and he can go one better. TREPORTI (2) resumed with a third in a 5-horse field here a fortnight ago, and he is better second up. He has the pole, and a 3kg claim should see him fighting out the finish here. MISS DE MEDICI (11) can turn it on when her mind is on the job, and she has won 2 of her 3 starts here over the trip. Include in all combos.
